name: Suzhou TFC Optical Communication Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou TFC Optical Communication Co., Ltd. is dedicated to the entire process of fiber optic network connectivity solutions, encompassing their design, development, manufacturing, and commercialization. Their extensive product line includes specialized Zirconia ceramic sleeves and fiber stubs. They also provide various TOSA/ROSA receptacle plugs and pigtails, specifically including models equipped with isolators, in addition to CNC-machined precision metal parts, barrel lenses, and fundamental fiber optic peripherals such as connectors, adapters, and attenuators. These offerings are deployed across a broad range of vital sectors, including metropolitan, backbone, and access telecommunication networks, data centers, large-scale Internet data storage, and cloud computing infrastructure. The company was founded in 2005 and its headquarters are located in Suzhou, China.
